# Fei Hu — fei.io

> Frontend & AI Product Engineer with 10+ years shipping production software.

## About

Fei Hu is a frontend and AI engineer based in the US. He builds interfaces people remember — where every interaction feels intentional, the code reads like prose, and the engineering behind it holds up under pressure. Over a decade of shipping brand-defining websites, enterprise dashboards, and SaaS platforms with complex business logic. On time, every time.

These days he is deep in AI: orchestrating multiple models, building RAG pipelines, and wiring up agentic systems that handle real workflows autonomously using MCP tooling and tool-calling patterns. He still cares about every pixel. Now there is intelligence behind it.

He flexes between tech lead and solo operator depending on what is needed — architecting, mentoring, unblocking. Known for communicating clearly, showing up without ego, and keeping the energy right even when timelines shift and requirements mutate.

## Expertise

- Frontend: React, TypeScript, styled-components, framer-motion, Next.js, Webpack, React Router, Redux, Tailwind CSS, Jest, Vite
- AI/ML: LLM orchestration, RAG pipelines, agentic systems, MCP tooling, tool-calling, Skills
- Backend: Node.js, REST APIs, system architecture
- Leadership: Tech lead, mentoring, cross-functional collaboration

## Lab

Free, browser-only tools. Nothing is uploaded; every one runs entirely on the visitor's machine.

- https://fei.io/lab/dither — Dither a photo into print marks: halftone, dots, ascii, or a lattice mesh, with per-effect controls, duotone ink and paper, an optional photo layer with blend modes, and a full-resolution PNG export
- https://fei.io/lab/pick-a-font — Font pairing by feel: four sliders map to free webfont pairings
- https://fei.io/lab/prompted — A gallery of AI-generated images and video, each with its verbatim prompt
- https://fei.io/lab/text-into-picture — A scroll effect that condenses a page of prose into an ASCII-halftone image
- https://fei.io/lab/cursor-tracked-video — Cursor position drives a video's playhead, frame-accurate
- https://fei.io/lab/interfaces-that-feel-better — Micro-interaction patterns with live demos
